name: @a11ign/control
description: The control plane: the machine that holds the fleet SSH key and dispatches work to it and to the lab. Deliberately dependency-free -- see ADR 0012.
//: NO `dependencies` KEY HAS ANY ENTRY, AND THAT IS THE POINT. ADR 0012 keeps the credential that can reconfigure twelve auto-logging-in Windows boxes away from npm's transitive surface, and this package is the code that runs on the machine holding it. `scripts/package-manifest.test.ts` asserts the emptiness rather than trusting this comment: the ADR made the same claim in prose and was violated on BOTH machines it described, for as long as nobody looked. The `devDependencies` are the repository's own tooling (the shared rstest config, the layout check, changesets, the typechecker): the control plane runs from a raw checkout and never installs them, and the same test names them, so a sixth is a reviewed change.
